entities.name: Johan Maurits Mohr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johan Maurits Mohr was a Dutch-German pastor who studied at Groningen University from 1733 and settled in Batavia in 1737. Mohr's greatest passion was in astronomy but he was also keenly interested in meteorology and in vulcanology.
